title: Groww Stocks & Mutual Funds Scraper Input
description: Search Groww for Indian stocks and mutual funds and export clean investment data.

source.title: Source
source.description: Choose which Groww asset type to scrape.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: One or more Groww search keywords, stock names, tickers, or fund names.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of unique assets to save across all keywords.

includeStockLivePrice.title: Include stock live price
includeStockLivePrice.description: Fetch Groww stock pages to extract embedded live or delayed stock price data when available.

includeNfoFunds.title: Include NFO funds
includeNfoFunds.description: Include NFO fund search results in addition to regular mutual fund schemes.
